The tundra stretches vast and wild, where frost and wind bite deep. Every inch of this land bears the mark of resilience and freedom.

Confluence of Currents
+1 [ICON_Food] Food to tiles in this [ICON_SUK_REGION] Region, +2 [ICON_Gold] Gold to improved water tiles.
Here the seas embrace each other and schools of fish reproduce in abundance. With each ebb and flow, the ocean bestows its most generous gift.

-1 [ICON_Movement] Movement to units in this [ICON_SUK_REGION] Region. Holy Site of this city receives +1 [ICON_Faith] Faith adjacency bonus from Coast and Lake tiles.

Vertical Climate

+1 [ICON_Science] Science to unimproved tiles in this [ICON_SUK_REGION] Region, increasing to +2 after researching the Scientific Theory technology. +30% [ICON_Production] Production towards Campus in this city.
Spring lies at the mountain's base, winter at its peak. Every inch of elevation here holds a distinct climate and life.

-1 [ICON_Movement] Movement to units in this [ICON_SUK_REGION] Region. +1 [ICON_Culture] Culture to unimproved tiles in this [ICON_SUK_REGION] Region; +1 additional [ICON_Culture] Culture if that tile is adjacent to Mountains.

Monsoon Valley
+2 [ICON_Food] Food to Jungle tiles in this [ICON_SUK_REGION] Region. +2 [ICON_Gold] Gold to Plantations in this [ICON_SUK_REGION] Region.

Oasis Trading Post

In the desert, there lies a clear spring. For merchants and travelers who arrive here, it marks both the end of their journey and the beginning of a new one.
+{1_num} [ICON_Gold] Gold from the adjacent Oasis {1_Num : plural 1?tile; other?tiles;}.

+{1_num} [ICON_Faith] Faith from the adjacent Volcanic Soil {1_Num : plural 1?tile; other?tiles;}.

Land of Abundance

Rich Oil Basin

All improved [ICON_RESOURCE_OIL] Oil resources yield 2 additional resource per turn. +30% [ICON_Production] Production towards Industrial Zone in this city. Reveal [ICON_RESOURCE_OIL] Oil after entering the Renaissance Era.

Rich Aluminium Veins
All improved [ICON_RESOURCE_ALUMINUM] Aluminium resources yield 2 additional resource per turn. +2 [ICON_Production] Production to Industrial Zones in this [ICON_SUK_REGION] Region.

Rich Uranium Veins
All improved [ICON_RESOURCE_URANIUM] Uranium resources yield 2 additional resource per turn. +2 [ICON_Production] Production to Industrial Zones in this [ICON_SUK_REGION] Region.
